<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks an aldehyde and forms a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester, which matches the Still‑Gennari HWE transformation. I will use a simple α,β‑unsaturated ester (methyl acrylate) as a representative product SMILES: “C=CC(=O)OC”. This should retrieve templates that can be applied to such a product. Then I will select the first returned template, retrieve its SMARTS, and apply it to the product to obtain the mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn) and the template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)OC",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
